name: Binjai Hall
description: Built in 2016 as part of North Hill Halls (comprising Binjai Hall, Tanjong Hall and Banyan Hall), Binjai Hall takes its name from the Binjai tree, a large tree of the mango family native to Singapore. It is part of the first large-scale high-rise development in Singapore that utilises the Prefabricated Prefinished Volumetric Construction (PPVC) system. The hall features a sky lounge, the largest gym on campus, and design studios for innovative pursuits.
